== Ingredients ==
*1 small jar (4.3 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] / 125 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) concentrado de coco or 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (250 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] / 8.5 [[Cookbook:Ounce|fl oz]]) fresh [[Cookbook:Coconut Milk|coconut milk]]
*4 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] (1 [[Cookbook:Liter|L]] / 1.1 [[Cookbook:Quart|qt]]) [[Cookbook:Water|water]]
*2 cups (200 g / 7.1 oz) [[Cookbook:Rice|rice]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*2–3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
*[[Cookbook:Raisin|Raisins]] to taste

== Procedure ==

# Combine everything in a pot. Cover, bring to a [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]], and reduce to very low heat.
# Cook until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is tender.
# Served with a half of avocado and grilled meats of all varieties.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* Some recipes add coconut browned in oil to the mix.
